slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Building practical security around everyday business operations

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Cyber Essentials should reflect how your business really works. We assess your environment against the recognised standard, then help you strengthen the controls that make the biggest difference.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: We review your current technology environment against recognised standards to see where you already meet the requirements and where gaps remain.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We evaluate accounts, authentication and access permissions so people have the right level of access and administrator rights are properly controlled.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: We assess laptops, desktops and mobile devices to confirm they are securely managed, up to date and aligned with Cyber Essentials.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: We give you a clearer understanding of your cyber security posture so you know exactly where you stand ahead of assessment.

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: We identify gaps early to prevent assessment delays, so certification is smoother and free of last-minute surprises.

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: We help you develop practical security standards that last beyond certification and keep protecting your business as it grows.
